name: homebase
description: HomeBase - shared household manager (Angular + NestJS + PostgreSQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run start -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test:ci -w apps/web
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres
